title: Language-Based Agent Control
abstract: arXiv:2605.12863v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper introduces language-based agent control (LBAC), a new programming model for agentic applications that brings techniques from programming languages and language-based security to the problem of agent control. In conventional programming, combinations of static typing and runtime enforcement have long been used to guarantee that well-typed programs satisfy user-specified policies, including policies for access control, information flow, data provenance, and more. The key idea behind LBAC is to extend these guarantees to agentic applications by requiring agents to generate programs that are themselves well typed in the context of the surrounding scaffolding code. Unsafe programs are rejected by the type-checker before execution, allowing policies to apply uniformly across the entire application, including both agent-generated behavior and developer-written scaffolding. translated_title: 基于语言的智能体控制
translated_abstract: 本文提出了基于语言的智能体控制（LBAC），这是一种面向智能体应用的新型编程模型，它将程序设计语言和基于语言的安全性领域的技术引入到智能体控制问题中。在传统编程中，静态类型与运行时强制执行相结合的方法长期以来被用于保证类型良好的程序满足用户指定的策略，包括访问控制、信息流、数据溯源等策略。LBAC 的核心思想是将这些保证扩展到智能体应用中，其方法是要求智能体生成的程序本身在与周围脚手架代码构成的上下文中是类型良好的。不安全的程序会在执行前被类型检查器拒绝，从而使策略能够统一地应用于整个应用程序，包括智能体生成的行为和开发者编写的脚手架代码。同时，LBAC 保留了相当的表达（能力）
tldr: 本文提出基于语言的智能体控制（LBAC）这一新型编程模型，通过要求智能体生成在周围脚手架上下文中类型良好的程序并由类型检查器在执行前拒绝不安全程序，将静态类型与运行时强制执行的安全保证扩展到智能体应用，使访问控制、信息流等策略能统一覆盖智能体生成行为与开发者编写的代码。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Language-Based Agent Control (LBAC), a new programming model that extends static typing and runtime enforcement guarantees to agentic applications by requiring agents to generate well-typed programs that are rejected by a type-checker before execution, enabling uniform policy enforcement across both agent-generated behavior and developer-written scaffolding.
